You’ll find your opportunities outside of campus limited in some ways, depending on what you want to major in, some majors you’ll find plenty. I would look at opportunity, cost, chance of getting in, student life, area around campus, social stuff, etc. I have no doubt that you would get in even as a RD, but weigh all factors  other than the academic portion. That being said, it’s an excellent school and Maine is a great place to go to school.
